# Which projects should you take?

> Paste your weekly hours and the project offers on the table and get the exact set to accept for the highest income, with the fee each declined project would need to earn its place. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
